title: SS28 Women's Woven Silhouette Direction
summary: SS28 women's wovens are projected to be lighter and more adaptable: technical blazers, adaptable skirts, fluid trousers and corset-line evening dresses.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 fabric fairs open with Première Vision Paris on 26-28 January 2027, and the shows run from June to October 2027. This report projects from the first SS28 forecaster and fair previews, the SS27 runways and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it after the fairs and again after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Future Snoops' SS28 performance preview: "smart translucent membranes, hyperlight wovens, and innovative technical silks", ultrastretch wovens, modular constructions and articulated seams<sup>[1]</sup>
- Performance, everyday and occasion wear merge: "technical blazers, adaptable skirts, and tailored baselayers", in sun-warmed neutrals and soft gradients<sup>[1]</sup>
- Lace, corsetry and dramatic silhouettes return, reinterpreted with lighter materials<sup>[2]</sup>
- SS27 was shaped by heat: Hypebeast called the sun "the true main character of SS27"<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Shapes to lead with
sections.body:
- **Technical blazer.**
- **Adaptable skirt** (wrap, convertible length).
- **Fluid trouser.**
- **Corset-line slip dress.**
- **Sheer shirt.**

design_implications: - Develop blocks early; confirm proportions after the shows.
commercial_implications: - Keep new shapes to tested quantities.
